follow-up time: 6 months before and after e-learning implementation
exposure: E-learning training program for interpreting cardiotocography (CTG)
cohort: Term births in five maternity hospitals in the Paris area, France
finding: The implementation of a one-session e-learning training program for CTG interpretation among midwives and obstetricians was not associated with a reduction in avoidable perinatal asphyxia.
